headline: What's your budgeting style?
lede: A 60-second quiz, and one tip that fits how you handle money.

pin.title: Budgeting Style Quiz: Planner, Saver, Spender or Avoider?
pin.description: Knowing how you handle money makes it easier to pick a system that sticks. Take the free 60-second quiz to find your budgeting style and get one tip that fits it, a good place to start before you plan the new year.
pin.alt: Quiz pin showing four budgeting styles: planner, saver, spender and avoider.
